text:
maria: Heads-up: I'm seeing warm-start failures for gpu-nodepools in eu-west1 when scaling from 0 -> N. Pods sit Pending ~20-40s while drivers/kernel modules load.
infra-bot: [alert] nodepool/gpu-eu-west1-2 scale event at 1767654310. nodes_provisioning=3
kevin: Which provider? GKE or self-provisioned? Any ENI/ip quota errors in kubelet logs?
maria: GKE standard. I see kubelet logs with `failed to allocate pod CIDR` and dmesg shows nvidia modules loaded late.
sasha: This rings a bell — we implemented the autoscaler "warmup handshake" in the provisioner last quarter, maybe helm values reverted in the last chart bump.
dmitri: Can you paste the nodepool terraform block? suspect we don't set `node_annotations = { node.k8s.io/warmup-ready = \"true\" }` until later
maria: pasting quick snippets:
```
module "gpu_nodepool" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/tf-modules//gke-nodepool"
  name = "gpu-eu-west1-2"
  min_size = 0
  max_size = 10
  machine_type = "n1-standard-8"
  gpu = "nvidia-tesla-t4"
  warmup_buffer = 1
}
```
kevin: helm autoscaler values on cluster? we need `handshakeEnabled: true` and `handshakeLabel` matching tf annotation
maria: current helm values show:
```
autoscaler:
  warmup:
    enabled: false
```
ops-sre: @maria set of actions: 1) enable warmup in helm 2) terraform apply to add `node.k8s.io/handshake=v1` annotation 3) run canary in eu-west1-a only
sasha: cost tradeoff: warmup buffer 1 per zone ~ adds $0.10/hr per zone, but cuts 30s average cold-start which improves p95 latency by ~40%
dmitri: also check ip-amplification: eu-west1 pod-ip usage at 78% on quotas, pre-warming nodes might exhaust pod IPs if AZ specific. Consider spreading pool across AZs or bumping ENI limits.
kevin: proposal: run rollout: (a) update helm chart to enable warmup+handshake + handshakeTimeout=25s (b) terraform patch adds handshake annotation (c) monitor `node_warmup_success{pool=\"gpu-eu-west1-2\"}` and `pod_pending_seconds` for 24h canary in eu-west1-a
maria: sounds good. I'll open PRs for helm + tf. I'll also run `kubectl get nodes -l nodepool=gpu-eu-west1-2 -o wide` and post results after patch.
ops-sre: assign @sasha to monitor costs and @dmitri for ip quota checks. if ENI quota hits, fallback = scale nodes across zones + reduce warmup_buffer
kevin: thanks all. :thumbsup:
